text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That was a good experience. I was able to throw myself into training much more than usual.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: The Kobe Shimbun Hai, and after that, the Kikuka Sho…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Slowly, but surely, my time in the winner's circle approaches.
